title: Therapeutic Closing Charge: Days After Release, Return or Discharge
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — days after a hold ends, therapeutic closing charge.** No day after the hold ended is charged: where the resident returned, the entry's days dated after the return date; where the bed was released, the entry's days dated after the release date, the day of release being the last held day; where the hold expired because the hospital discharged the resident to another setting, the entry's days dated after the hold's last held day; where the hold ended after the entry's last day, or has not ended, none.

| The reservation records | Days of the therapeutic closing entry not charged |
|---|---|
| a return dated on or before the entry's last day | the entry's days dated after the return date |
| a release dated before the entry's last day | the entry's days dated after the release date (the day of release is the last held day) |
| an expiry because the hospital discharged the resident to another setting, with the hold's last held day before the entry's last day | the entry's days dated after the hold's last held day |
| a hold that ended after the entry's last day, or has not ended | none |

These uncharged days are the therapeutic closing entry's last days. **Hypothetical cases** (a released hold whose entry runs from the 1st through the 25th, no day reversed): a release dated the 18th leaves the 19th through the 25th, 7 days, uncharged; a release dated the 25th leaves none. The days so left uncharged are never more than the entry's days.
